scenario: Distinct guarded review write family with stable phase receipts and holder revocation

stages.label: distinct-family-and-local-credential
stages.explanation: A fifth retention plan copies only the original minimum plan's public parameters. One distinct guarded job captures its own review and one local credential. Exact prepare and own show retain the same guard; status is observation rather than permission.

stages.label: legacy-refusals-before-effects
stages.explanation: Legacy step, status, prepare and catalog selection refuse the new family because its legacy coordination control is absent. New prepare refuses an existing legacy job. Wrong step/revoke credentials and changed immutable prepare requests leave metadata unchanged.

stages.label: three-protected-phases-and-discarded-reply
stages.explanation: Three authenticated steps perform prepared to ready, ready to linked and linked to completed. The actual successful complete prepared response is discarded. Changed IDs in sealed slots and reusing one operation in another phase conflict. The old review reader accepts the completed historical review.

stages.label: completed-reply-recovery-without-live-targets
stages.explanation: After completion, the new plan and review target are temporarily absent. The real discarded prepared response is recovered exactly; all three stable saved phase responses remain historical observations. Own show and exact prepare need neither live target. Authentication and operation conflicts are checked without effects.

stages.label: irreversible-holder-revocation
stages.explanation: With both live targets still absent, the holder revokes its own local capability. Own show, exact prepare and exact revoke preserve history and never reactivate it. Revoked access blocks new and cached steps; wrong credentials fail authentication before the missing target is observed.

stages.label: preserved-history-and-explicit-limits
stages.explanation: Both temporary paths are restored. The old review reader still returns the completed record. Six earlier write statuses, two released lease pages, three blocked restore jobs and original lstat control metadata remain unchanged. Source and live public histories retain their original observations; the new job remains completed and revoked.

limits: One distinct guarded family rejects known legacy public step, status, prepare and catalog selection. It neither converts legacy jobs nor creates their old intent or lock. Filesystem owners, direct private helpers, direct syscalls and other copies remain outside the managed gate.

The holder proves possession of one local credential. Principal and actor are self-declared labels; there is no external identity, OS isolation, semantic authority, lease enforcement or issuer policy for this new family.

Each of three immutable result slots binds one operation and expected phase. Exact saved responses report their historical target; they do not describe the current phase or authenticate who performed the historical effect.

The actual complete prepared reply is discarded and recovered exactly only after later phases completed, while the new plan and review are absent. Current credential and revocation checks remain mandatory even for cached protected responses.

Holder revocation is irreversible within supported APIs and blocks both new and cached steps. Exact prepare, own show and exact revoke retain history without reactivation. Revocation waits behind an admitted step; it does not cancel, recall or undo completed work.

An effect and its saved result are not one atomic transaction. The source supports an exact POST observation when a receipt is absent, but this normal scenario does not demonstrate interruption, partial writes, missing-receipt injection, races, power loss, expiry or clock regression. Partial controls are not repaired.

Only the new plan and review are temporarily hidden and both return in finally. Legacy control metadata, released lease heads and public source/live histories remain unchanged; no domain document, code, archival authorization or deletion is produced by a review receipt.

The driver reads public responses, credential markers and lstat metadata. It never reads private control bodies, lease SQL rows or staging contents. No external LLM, semantic quality or agent throughput is measured.
